title: Concept: Client certificate validation left empty in a trust manager in java — review required
description: In java, checkClientTrusted is implemented as an empty method. The contract is to throw when the chain is not trusted; returning normally means every chain is trusted. This pattern appears in quick mutual-TLS setups where the client is authenticated by another header, leaving the certificate path as decoration.
applicability: java services that require or offer mutual TLS.
risk: Authentication bypass on the client-certificate path; HIGH severity.
